verdict.rationale: Mastra's docs say you can create a first agent with a single command and run the server locally. Studio provides a UI for testing agents, and a community user confirms running the quickstart, creating an agent and chatting with it. The evidence does not name the actual command or package channel (installer script, npm package or Docker image), and nothing shows the setup takes only minutes, so story coverage is partial. Missing for 10: the documented install command and its package channel (npm/Docker/script), evidence of time-to-working-chat in minutes, and independent hands-on install corroboration beyond one brief comment.

support.subject: As a self-hoster, I can install the assistant on my own machine with one documented command — installer script, npm/pip package, or Docker image — and reach a working chat in minutes
